data.title: Initial Level Placement
data.description: A high-level scan to establish your current CEFR baseline (A2-B2).

sections.sentence: Tom is older than Mia. Mia is older than Leo. Who is the youngest?
sections.explain: Leo is younger than Mia, and Mia is younger than Tom, so Leo is the youngest.

sections.sentence: The shop opens at 9:00. Sara arrives at 8:45. What must she do?
sections.explain: Sara arrives fifteen minutes before the shop opens, so she must wait.

words.word: She must wait for the shop to open.
She can enter the shop immediately.
She has arrived after the shop closed.

sections.sentence: Every red box is heavy. This box is red. What can we conclude?
sections.explain: If every red box is heavy and this box is red, this box must be heavy.

words.word: The box may be empty, so it cannot be heavy.

sections.sentence: Anna is standing to the left of Ben. Ben is standing to the left of Carla. Who is in the middle?
sections.explain: The order is Anna, Ben, Carla, so Ben is in the middle.

sections.sentence: A bus leaves every 20 minutes. One leaves at 10:00. When does the next bus leave?
There are twelve apples. Four people receive the same number. How many apples does each person receive?
sections.explain: Twelve divided equally among four people gives three apples each.

sections.sentence: It is raining, and Noah has no umbrella. Which result is most likely?
sections.explain: A person outside in the rain without an umbrella is likely to get wet.

words.word: Noah will become warmer because of the rain.
The rain will stop because Noah has no umbrella.

sections.sentence: Lena is Mark's sister. Mark is Eva's father. Who is Lena to Eva?
sections.explain: Lena is the sister of Eva's father, so Lena is Eva's aunt.

sections.sentence: The blue book is below the green book. The red book is above the green book. Which book is highest?
sections.explain: The red book is above the green book, and the green book is above the blue book.

sections.sentence: Only people with a ticket may enter. Daniel entered the hall. What must be true?
sections.explain: If only ticket holders may enter and Daniel entered, Daniel must have had a ticket.

words.word: Daniel entered before tickets were needed.
